Extract console interaction into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move command reading, greetings, task feedback, errors, and separators from Topaz into a dedicated Ui class. This keeps Topaz focused on coordinating commands while preserving the existing console output and prepares the codebase for later Parser, Storage, and TaskList extractions.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task collection into TaskList
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of the mutable task collection and move task retrieval, insertion, removal, and completion-status operations into it. Topaz now coordinates commands and persistence through TaskList rather than manipulating the underlying list directly, creating a clear boundary for the later Storage extraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract persistence into Storage
commitResults.messageBody: Move data-file path handling, directory creation, task serialization, loading, and saved-record reconstruction from Topaz into Storage. Topaz now initializes Storage once and delegates load and save operations to it, while retaining only rollback coordination for changes that cannot be persisted.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract command parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Move numbered-command validation, task-description validation, date parsing, and Todo, Deadline, and Event construction from Topaz into Parser. Topaz continues to coordinate command branches and side effects, while Parser now owns the interpretation of command arguments and associated input errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce commands for list and exit
commitResults.messageBody: Add the abstract Command base class and move the stateless list and exit behaviours into ListCommand and ExitCommand. Topaz now executes these command objects while retaining the remaining command branches, establishing the command-execution pattern in a small, behaviour-preserving step.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract mark and unmark commands
commitResults.messageBody: Move completion-status updates, persistence, rollback, and feedback into MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand. Parser now creates these commands after validating task numbers, allowing Topaz to delegate the mark and unmark behaviours while delete continues to use the shared task-number parser until its own extraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract deletion into DeleteCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Move task removal, persistence, rollback, and deletion feedback into DeleteCommand. Parser now validates and constructs the delete command, which lets Topaz delegate every numbered state-changing operation to command objects.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task addition into AddCommand
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce AddCommand to own task insertion, persistence, rollback, and confirmation feedback for todo, deadline, and event tasks. Parser now returns an AddCommand for each valid task-creation input, removing the final add/save coordination method from Topaz.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse every input into a command
commitResults.messageBody: Add Parser.parse to recognize every supported command and return the appropriate Command object, including list and exit. Simplify Topaz's main loop to parse once, execute once, and inspect the command's exit flag, completing the command-pattern control flow while preserving existing output and errors.

Add find command for task searches
commitResults.messageBody:
Task lists cannot be filtered by a keyword, making it harder to locate
an existing task as the list grows.

Add a case-insensitive description search and expose it through a new
find command with matching-task output. Validate missing keywords and
cover the feature with JUnit and UI test cases.

Configure Checkstyle and expand Javadocs
commitResults.messageBody:
The project lacks automated enforcement for its Java coding standard,
and public API documentation omits applicable Javadoc tags.

Configure Gradle Checkstyle for main and test sources, and add the
relevant @param, @return, and @throws tags to production APIs.

Use the SE-EDU-aligned configuration so style issues are detected
consistently during project checks.
